features.name: Task Creation
features.description: Users can create new tasks with title and description.
user_stories: As a user, I can create a new task so that I can track my work.
As a user, I can add a description to my task so that I remember details.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the task page, When I click create and enter a title, Then a new task is saved.
Given I create a task, When I submit without a title, Then I see an error message.

features.name: Task Completion
features.description: Users can mark tasks as complete to track progress.
user_stories: As a user, I can mark a task as complete so that I know it is done.
As a user, I can see completed tasks separately so that I can review my accomplishments.
acceptance_criteria: Given I have an active task, When I click complete, Then the task is marked as completed.
Given a task is completed, When I view my tasks, Then it appears in the completed section.

features.name: Task Deletion
features.description: Users can permanently delete tasks they no longer need.
user_stories: As a user, I can delete a task so that I can remove unnecessary items.
As a user, I can confirm deletion so that I do not accidentally remove tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given I select a task, When I click delete and confirm, Then the task is permanently removed.
Given I click delete, When I cancel the confirmation, Then the task remains in the list.

features.name: Task List View
features.description: Users can view all their tasks in an organized list.
user_stories: As a user, I can view all my tasks so that I can see what needs to be done.
As a user, I can filter tasks by status so that I can focus on active or completed tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given I open the app, When the page loads, Then I see a list of all my tasks.
Given I have tasks, When I apply a filter, Then only tasks matching the filter are displayed.
